FIX ONE FOLLOW-UP REVIEW FINDING ON PR #799 (validate-constraints action). Target branch codex/run-38012804725-1, expected head acb4929; fail closed and write nothing if it moved. Only scripts/operator/actions/v3-system-search-validate-constraints.sh and tests/test_v3_system_search_validate_constraints.py may change.

FINDING (P2, ~line 157): run.pid is never removed when the detached runner exits, so a reused PID can make `kill -0` succeed and every later `start` stop with validation_already_running even though pg_stat_activity shows nothing. CHANGE: (a) in the detached launch command, after the psql subshell finishes write the exit line and then `rm -f /tmp/edfinder-validate-constraints/run.pid` (inside the same background group, so the pid file disappears when the runner ends); (b) harden runner_pid_alive(): consider the pid alive only if `kill -0` succeeds AND the process command line (read via `cat /proc/<pid>/cmdline | tr '\0' ' '`) contains 'psql' and 'run.sql'; otherwise treat the pid file as stale, delete it, and return not-alive. Add tests: stale pid (kill -0 ok but cmdline unrelated) → start proceeds and launches; live runner (cmdline contains psql run.sql) → validation_already_running; the launch command contains the rm -f of run.pid after the exit line.

VALIDATION: 1. bash -n the script  2. python -m pytest tests/test_v3_system_search_validate_constraints.py -q -p no:cacheprovider  3. git diff --name-only acb4929 lists only the two allowed files. Commit message: 'ops: validate-constraints runner clears its pid file and verifies pid identity'.
